overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the committee could list a listening session on its notice without holding it as part of the meeting, and attending a separate session without deliberating was not a meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the notice's 'Community Listening Session' topic made the session part of the August 5 meeting, so holding it separately violated the law.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law when it included the listening session on its meeting notice but did not in fact hold a listening session as part of its meeting.

allegations.summary: Whether the committee's adjournment and members' attendance at a separate listening session, with no members speaking, was an unnoticed meeting or deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: Nor do we find that the Committee violated the Law when the Committee voted to adjourn its August 5 meeting and thereafter attended a listening session at which no members of the Committee deliberated.
